reading.zh: 从左到右：init 建图器，poses 存关键帧位姿，accumulator 累积观测，ray-veto 否决不可信射线，rasterize 栅格化成地图；箭头是自观测累积到出图的顺序。
reading.en: Left to right: init creates the mapper, poses stores keyframe poses, accumulator accumulates observations, ray-veto vetoes rays that must not be trusted and rasterize turns it into the map; arrows run from accumulating to emitting the map.
